methodology.retreatRng: separate independently seeded stream, per eligible ship, rounds 1 and 2 ONLY
methodology.ratio: larger attacker / smaller defender; budget cross uses build resources
methodology.survival: battle-exit active + escaped; means INCLUDE zero survivors
methodology.randomTargeting: each armed ship fires once per round at a uniformly random live enemy; escort cover retained; within-round overkill wasted; shared ±8% roll per side
methodology.liveTargeting: random shooter order; skip targets destroyed by earlier shots in same round; cargo only after combat targets clear; no shot damage spills; BOTH sides retain start-of-round firing rights; cargo-only vs cargo-only is no battle
methodology.ratioPolicy: battle-start combatValue excludes cargo; side chance/HP threshold: ratio<1.5 both 25%/25%; 1.5<=ratio<2 weak33%/30% strong20%/30%; 2<=ratio<3 weak50%/50% strong15%/30%; ratio>=3 weak75%/70% strong10%/25%; HP threshold inclusive, rounds 1 and 2 only
methodology.loser: control loser; clearedLoser excludes unresolved mutual survival
methodology.resources: Docker memory=2g, memory-swap=2g, cpus=1; Node heap=1536 MiB, one worker
methodology.personalShields: ratio model: researched maximum HP * 0.25; no SHIP_SHIELDS research multiplier; full at battle start, never regenerates between rounds; radiation wounds remain on hull; cargo included; Aegis=0; pre-battle fleet escape excluded
